description: [phase 3.8 38i, kind `interface`] A semantic run (port/test/semantic.py gate) replaces every recorded DISPATCH (root-handler calls) but still takes the polled device state from the trace: the cursor reads (CURSOR records; View_toLocal -> jgld Display::getCursor 0x10066780), GetKeyboardState (capsLockOff 0x004321d0) and the GetAsyncKeyState reads outside the root handlers (mainLoop P6 0x00418d7d, H2 0x0041ed39). The aim of a championship shot is that cursor: the Swing click (mainLoop 0x0041f29d) copies the target the frame computed from it. Measured: in all 165 accepted COMMAND segments every one of the 344,524 cursor reads equals the harness's last cursor move before it (DELIVER kind 1, SimGolfShim_SetVirtualCursor; 1,667 moves; reads before the first move of a slice equal the slice's first read; log/p38/38i/cursor_moves.py), so a PointerMove (Aim) input kind reproduces the cursor exactly. It needs a cursor hook in tick.cpp (TraceInput::cursor / TkBase::cursor_read): a move takes effect at the first cursor read after its clock position, and FrameIo's cursor list keeps no positions; not done in 38i because stream 38j edits tick.cpp at the same time.
path to resolution: a PointerMove input kind served by tick.cpp's cursor reads, the DELIVER cursor records as its dispatch points, then the gate with the trace's CURSOR records ignored

description: [phase 3.8 38i, kind `field`] portsim/sim/semantic.h names the 75 key actions by what mainLoop H1's case does in the port's transcription (char switch 0x0041c5b2 keyed through the byte table 0x0042191c, code switch 0x0041de11); what several of those effects mean in the game is not determined: g_flags bit 10 toggled by 'T' (0x0041d02c), the counter g_ui_5a34e4 + 0xc and the three-value cycle g_ui_542f20 of Tab (0x0041c9ea), panel mode 5 set by Space (0x0041cfe0), the shot-style values 0, -1, 1, 3, 4 that 's' 'f' 'd' 'h' 'l' set in panel mode 3 (g_playerShotStyle, re/names/model_b_globals.tsv), the list numbers 2, 7, 10, 13, 17 and 4 / 5 that 'f' 's' 'v' 't' 'w' 'r' pass to panelListSelect, and the Random::range(5) slot of 'b' (0x0041c997). The names say the code's effect (ToggleFlag10, ShotStyle0OrList7, ListPanel13 ...), which is exact; renaming changes no binding (ids are stable).
path to resolution: name them when the UI phase reads the panels and the HUD these keys switch

description: [phase 3.8 38i, kind `interface`] A Click's target (semantic.h ClickTarget) is evaluated on the state at the click's dispatch point (P6's pumpInput483bd0 0x004199e0 or H1's pumpMessages 0x0041c0cd for frame-body dispatches), while H2 routes the button word later in the same frame (press-code entry 0x0041e36c), after P7 and H1's key switch, which can change g_panelListMode, the pending placement word f_w_4c2e00 + 0x10 or the camera. Measured: every Panel and Hud route of the 165 segments equals the handler the raw run's H2 called with that point (log/p38/38i/route_check.py, SG_TICK_TRACE), and every segment run with the targets stated and checked equals its raw run; the World, Swing, Place, GolferAction and TerrainEdit routes are checked only through those runs, not against the branch H2 takes.
path to resolution: an H2 branch log (which press-code arm H2 takes per click) compared with the routes; or evaluate the route at H2's own entry through a tick.cpp hook
